title: The Schrödinger Ornstein--Uhlenbeck flow: dispersion, restriction and nonlinear dynamics
summary: We study the Schrödinger evolution generated by the isotropic Ornstein--Uhlenbeck operator \[ \mathscr L=Δ-\langle x,\nabla\rangle \] in $L^2(\mathbb R^d,dγ)$, where $dγ$ is the invariant Gaussian measure. Combining the classical lens correspondence between the free Schrödinger equation and the harmonic oscillator with Gaussian conjugation, we identify the free Schrödinger structure hidden in the Ornstein--Uhlenbeck evolution.
